_readme: Hand-made route fixes, applied on every regeneration. 'skip': quests the route must never use (bugged, removed, not worth it) with the reason. 'notes': text shown under a quest's pickup step. 'dungeon_exempt': dungeon quests the dungeon rule (see gen_route.py) may leave out, with the reason they can't be done. 'dungeon_backlog': per faction, dungeon rule gaps the routes had when the rule was introduced (2026-11-05); fix them in the generator and remove the entry; re-baseline only when a fix raises the number of dungeon quests done (see the generator README). Keys are quest IDs as strings. 'prereqs': quests that must be turned in before a quest is offered, which QuestieDB doesn't record (mostly Forever's own chains), as {"pre": [quest IDs], "why": reason}. 'not_mobs': NPCs without faction or vendor data that the area danger model would count as hostile mobs but that are townsfolk, guards or props, with the reason.

dungeon_exempt.96984: City of Dalaran: Heart of Disruption (Horde). Its chain goes through Key to the City (93680), whose Grimy Key comes from object 670427, which QuestieDB has no data for (2026-11-12), so the route can't place it. Remove once the object has spawns.
